attempted_claim: Let F_7 denote the Fano plane, i.e. the linear 3-uniform hypergraph on 7 vertices with 7 edges forming PG_2(2). Let ex_lin(n,F_7) denote the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex linear 3-uniform hypergraph containing no copy of F_7 as a (not necessarily induced) subhypergraph. Determine ex_lin(n,F_7) for all sufficiently large n, and characterize the extremal hypergraphs up to isomorphism.
decisive_failure: The investigation established only the universal pair-counting cap, a weak transversal lower-bound family, and isolated sharp witnesses at n=9 and n=27. It did not produce residue-class existence theory, stability analysis, or extremal uniqueness results, so the exact all-n formula and isomorphism classification remain open.
